title: async 1:1 agenda + hat-tracker (scratch)
content:
Purpose: lightweight async-first 1:1 notes to speed prep + focus live time on coaching, decision-making, and unblocking. Can be read before meeting — mark items as read/commented. Use the hat-tracker to surface what hat each of us is wearing this week (IC, on-call, PE, recruiting, ramping).

Context: follow-up from last 1:1 (11/30). Focus this cycle on the new batching experiment, career check-in, and trade-offs for prioritizing tech-debt vs. feature for Q1 roadmap.

Pre-read (please skim and add comments inline):
- Short status: batching experiment A/B (dev branch) — currently running on canary pool; latency p95 regressed by ~40ms under 95-token workloads, throughput up 13% at scale. Logs + perf dashboard attached in linked artifacts.
- PR: runtime PR #987 implements KV prefetch heuristics — awaiting perf-signoff and SRE validation.
- Career note: Rafael to propose manager shadow session in Jan for mentorship plan.

Hat-tracker (quick one-liners; mark one hat each):
- Rafael: IC (feature lead) / interviewing focus (2 screens this week)
- Noor: On-call / infra performance owner
- Eliot: Platform eng (roadmap alignment) / mentoring two new hires

Top agenda (time-boxed for 30m meeting):
1) Live unblock — batching experiment gating decision (8m)
   - Question: revert to previous heuristics or roll forward with canary and mitigation (throttle small requests)?
   - My take: keep canary, add temporary small-request fast-path and alert rule; need SRE signoff today.
   - Decision needed: yes/no for fast-path rollout to prod by Mon.

2) Career checkpoint (8m)
   - Quick wins: Rafael identify 1-2 cross-team projects to broaden scope.
   - Ask: what does success look like in next 3 months? Concrete stretch goal + measurable metric.

3) Tech-debt vs. feature prioritization (6m)
   - Trade-off: reduce memory pressure on KV cache (low-level refactor, 3 sprints) vs. shipping improved API telemetry UI (2 sprints).
   - Propose: defer UI one sprint if KV refactor reduces cost per-token by >6%.

4) Quick sync on hiring / interviewing feedback (4m)
   - Note: two onsite candidates scheduled; Rafael to collect loop feedback and summarize.

Open questions / notes to self:
- Confirm canary pool capacity for weekend stress test (ping SRE slack #sre-prod). 
- Check with product on whether telemetry UI is blocking any customer renewals (product-hosted-api). If yes, reprioritize.
- Do a short playbook entry for 'small request fast-path' rollback steps.

Action items (explicit, owner, due):
- Rafael: draft rollback/playbook for fast-path by 12/09 (owner: Rafael) -> TODO
- Noor: run 3rd canary stress run and share perf dashboard by 12/09 (owner: Noor)
- Eliot: collect interviewing notes and recommended shortlist by 12/10 (owner: Eliot)
- Rafael + Eli: block trade-off decision meeting with product (15m) by 12/10 (owner: Rafael)

Async flow (how to use this doc):
- Add quick inline reply if you only have a 1-line update.
- If any item needs >2 bullets, add under "deep-dive" and we'll punt to async doc or a follow-up session.
- Mark hat-tracker with emoji or short update before the meeting to keep live time focused on coaching.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Try coaching question: "What would help you remove one decision from your plate this week?"
- Bring up promotion mapping next cycle (collect examples of cross-team impact).
- Remind to update roadmap view with cost delta once KV refactor perf numbers land.

Follow-up template (post-meeting): copy this doc, append outcomes, mark actions done, and set next meeting date.
